customer_status_desc_pending: We have received your order and it is queued for preparation.
customer_status_desc_preparing: Our kitchen is actively preparing your delicious order.
customer_status_desc_ready: Your order is READY! Please proceed to the collection counter.
customer_status_desc_collected: Thank you! Your order has been collected.
customer_status_desc_cancelled: This order has been cancelled. Please speak with the cashier.
notification_enable_desc: Enable push notifications to receive an alert on your phone the moment your order is prepared.

notification_denied_msg: Push notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Please watch this screen for updates.
notification_unsupported_msg: Push notifications are not supported on this device/browser. Keep this page open to track your order.
order_not_found_desc: The order tracking link is invalid or may have expired.
order_syncing_desc: This order was placed offline at the counter and will appear here as soon as connectivity syncs.
kds_no_orders: No active orders in kitchen right now.
pos_empty_cart: No items added yet. Click products to build the order.
pos_scan_instruction: Ask customer to scan with smartphone camera:
